Verify Now Blog > Notice for AI-Generated Design Files and Manufacturing Requirements Notice for AI-Generated Design Files and Manufacturing Requirements by: Mila Oct 28,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in PCB Manufacturing Information Now AI tools can help customers generate PCB, PCBA, 3D printing, and CNC machining designs, along with detailed manufacturing notes and documentation. However, AI-generated submissions may contain excessive or redundant files, lengthy instructions, conflicting requirements, or supplementary documents that are not directly relevant to production. To ensure accurate order processing, please note the following: 1. Orders with Extensive or Unclear Documentation May Require Additional Confirmation If your submission contains a large number of files, lengthy AI-generated notes, or unclear or conflicting manufacturing instructions, we may not begin our evaluation immediately. Our team first needs to identify the actual production files and confirm the requirements that are essential to manufacturing. Example: 2. Not All Notes and Documents Can Be Reviewed or Followed Due to the volume and complexity of some AI-generated documentation, we cannot guarantee that every note<dynamic-value>, or supplementary document will be reviewed or followed. Documents that are excessively long, redundant, irrelevant, or inconsistent with the primary manufacturing files may be disregarded during the initial evaluation. Please do not assume that uploading a document means every instruction in it has been acknowledged or accepted. Example： 3. Final Manufacturing Requirements Must Be Confirmed Before the review, our sales representative will contact you and provide a document summarizing the manufacturing requirements for your confirmation. This document will help establish a clear and consistent foundation for production. Please carefully review the document and confirm that it accurately reflects your final requirements before we proceed. Any critical specifications, special processes, tolerances, material requirements, or other essential instructions should be explicitly stated and confirmed. 4. How to Help Us Process Your Order Faster To help us evaluate your project efficiently, we recommend that you: Upload only the necessary and latest production files. Clearly identify the files to be used for manufacturing. Keep manufacturing instructions concise and organized. Highlight critical specifications and special requirements. Remove duplicate, outdated, irrelevant, or conflicting documents. Respond promptly to requests for clarification and final confirmation. Our goal is to manufacture your project according to your confirmed requirements. Clear production files and concise, verified instructions help reduce misunderstandings, avoid unnecessary delays, and ensure a smoother manufacturing process. Disclaimer: PCBWay reserves the right to decline inquiries and quotation requests based on AI-generated content or files. PCBWay shall not be responsible for any issues, errors, losses, or other consequences arising from AI-generated content, files, or instructions submitted by customers, particularly where such content is inaccurate, incomplete, or unclear.
